title: Cyber Security Architect
description:
**Job Description: WAAP Platform Engineer**

**The role**

The WAAP Platform Engineer provides engineering leadership for HSBC’s Web Application and API Protection capability across multiple platforms and thousands of applications. The role translates capability strategy and cyber architecture into actionable engineering artefacts, platform standards, reusable templates, guardrails, and implementation guidance.

Working closely with Cyber Architecture, the WAAP Capability Owner, Engineering, and Operations, the role ensures platform designs and controls are robust, scalable, supportable, and aligned with HSBC security and compliance requirements. It also evaluates non-standard business requirements, provides product-focused technical guidance, and ensures deviations are appropriately risk-assessed and documented.

The successful candidate will combine strong WAAP engineering expertise with effective stakeholder leadership. They will drive continuous improvement, discovery, and efficacy testing; connect capability and architecture intent with platform delivery; and establish structured feedback loops so that operational lessons, engineering challenges, and improvement opportunities are captured and acted upon.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engineering leadership for the WAAP capability: Act as a primary engineering lead, setting technical direction and promoting consistent engineering practices across the capability.
* Collaborate with Cyber Architecture and the WAAP Capability Owner to translate strategy, target-state architecture, control requirements, and product priorities into actionable engineering artefacts and delivery plans.
* Platform standards, templates, and guardrails: Partner with Operations to define and maintain platform standards, reference patterns, reusable engineering templates, configuration baselines, and guardrails for the seven Cyber-supported WAAP solutions.
* Ensure engineering artefacts are secure, robust, scalable, automatable, supportable, and aligned with HSBC security, risk, and compliance requirements.
* Business engagement for non-standard solutions: Engage business and technology stakeholders to assess requirements that fall outside approved patterns or standard platform capabilities.
* Provide technical options and product guidance, challenge unnecessary variation, and ensure approved deviations are risk-assessed, documented, governed, and traceable.
* Continuous improvement, discovery, and efficacy testing: Identify opportunities for new or enhanced WAAP functions, controls, automation, and operating practices.
* Lead technical discovery, proofs of concept, and efficacy testing for platform capabilities, managed and custom controls, and emerging protection requirements.
* Drive innovation, engineering quality, and delivery efficiency while keeping pace with evolving cyber threats, technology changes, and business needs.
* Feedback loops across capability, architecture, platform, and operations: Provide structured feedback to Capability and Architecture teams so lessons learned, control gaps, and improvement opportunities inform roadmaps and design decisions.
* Work with Engineering and Operations teams to understand delivery and support challenges, prioritize improvements, and provide clear product and engineering leadership through implementation and lifecycle management.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Own the quality, consistency, and technical integrity of engineering outputs for the WAAP capability.
* Produce and maintain engineering standards, reference designs, patterns, configuration baselines, decision records, and implementation guidance.
* Ensure requirements and architecture decisions are translated into deliverable, testable, and operationally sustainable solutions.
* Define acceptance criteria and evidence for platform controls, including functional, security, resilience, performance, and efficacy outcomes.
* Promote automation and repeatability through infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, APIs, and CI/CD integration where appropriate.
* Assess non-standard designs and exceptions, documenting technical rationale, risks, compensating controls, ownership, and remediation or exit plans.
* Coordinate technical discovery and evaluation of new WAAP capabilities, product features, and vendor solutions.
* Use operational telemetry, incidents, tuning outcomes, engineering feedback, and threat intelligence to identify and prioritize platform improvements.
* Facilitate design reviews and technical forums, communicating decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support the WAAP roadmap by identifying dependencies, technical debt, lifecycle risks, and opportunities to simplify or consolidate the platform estate.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Demonstrable experience engineering enterprise WAAP, WAF, API security, bot management, DDoS protection, or related application-edge security platforms.
* Experience providing technical leadership across complex, multi-platform environments and translating strategy and architecture into implementable engineering outcomes.
* Strong understanding of web and API protocols, modern application architectures, common attack techniques, and layered mitigation strategies.
* Practical experience defining platform standards, reusable patterns, configuration baselines, guardrails, and technical documentation.
* Experience with several major WAAP or WAF technologies, such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Akamai, F5, Cloudflare, and an understanding of their deployment and operating models.
* Knowledge of cloud, network, application delivery, identity, observability, resilience, and DevSecOps principles relevant to WAAP services.
* Experience with automation, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, source control, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to design and execute proofs of concept, control validation, and efficacy testing, and to turn results into clear engineering recommendations.
* Sound risk judgement with experience assessing exceptions, documenting technical decisions, and working within security, compliance, and governance frameworks.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance security outcomes, business needs, operability, cost, and delivery constraints.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence architecture, capability, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders.
* A collaborative, outcome-focused approach and a commitment to continuous learning, service improvement, and engineering excellence.

Our People & Culture and Legal teams make sure we provide a highly ethical working environment where everyone at Priceline can bring their whole selves to work and deliver their very best each day. We want you to thrive – to feel safe, supported, valued, and growing to your highest potential!
  
  
**Why Is This Job a Big Deal**
The position is responsible for coordinating Governance, Risk & Control (“GRC”) processes as part of the Privacy/AI Governance and Cyber Advisory team at Priceline. This role requires an understanding of our existing personal data processing environment and infrastructure, controls and risk profile. It also requires an understanding of the company’s innovative utilization of AI technology to serve our customers and our own productivity in an ethical, responsible and trustworthy manner.
  
  
The Analyst will be part of a high-performing and diverse privacy team at Priceline, a US subsidiary of the biggest online travel company of the world. He/she will be part of a dynamic, responsive team that has multiple exciting challenges.
  
  
**In This Role You Will Get To**

* Coordinate end-to-end privacy GRC projects and initiatives to improve our compliance & risk posture.
* Mature and maintain our current NIST-P framework and support our analysis of NIST-AI (or similar framework) for adoption, enhancing the frameworks and controls based on recommendations from maturity and risk assessments.
* Monitor control performance across the business for timely and effective execution.
* Assistance in executing risk assessments and providing support as necessary to our third-party risk assurance process.
* Adoption, maintenance and enhancement of our GRC tools.
* Maintain and improve our policy framework, in accordance with our regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Track progress of issues reported, gaps/risks identified, and support in the creation of dashboards and metrics to oversee mitigation.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the Company, such as Security, Technology, Data, Marketing and People & Culture.
* Act as a privacy & AI champion.
* Perform other duties as requested.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 3 years of experience working in a privacy or data protection GRC function
* BIG4 experience is a plus.
* Experience coordinating an external NIST audit is a plus.
* One or more industry-standard privacy professional certifications, such as AIGC, CIPP-M, CIPP-E or CIPP-US
* Knowledge of control and compliance frameworks, e.g. NIST-P, NIST-AI, NIST-CSF
* Basic understanding of privacy and security by design, responsible AI development and engineering best practices.
* Experience driving GRC initiatives in a proactive and independent manner.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in fast-paced environments.
* Solid problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Experience and solid skills in working with AI enterprise platforms and tooling, e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to priceline.com: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics are essential.

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Compliance & Reporting

+ Functional proficiency in Windows and Linux operating system administration.

* Imperva DAM Certification (Strongly Preferred)

Good-to-Haves
  
  

* Practical experience integrating Imperva logs with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, IBM QRadar, or Microsoft Sentinel.

description:
**Technical Consultant – Fraud & Security Intelligence**
**About The Role**
Help leading financial institutions across Asia Pacific solve complex Fraud and Financial Crime challenges through innovative analytics, AI, and enterprise technology.
  
  
As a Technical Consultant within SAS's Fraud & Security Intelligence practice, you'll work directly with customers to understand their business challenges, lead discovery workshops, design enterprise solutions, and deliver successful transformation programmes across the region.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise with business consulting while building trusted customer relationships and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead customer workshops to understand business, functional, and technical requirements.
* Design, implement, and optimize Fraud, Financial Crime, and Compliance solutions that address customer business and regulatory requirements.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs and implementation approaches.
* Deliver end-to-end solution implementation, from requirements analysis and solution configuration through testing, deployment, and post-production support.
* Lead technical workstreams and collaborate with customer business and technology teams to solve complex implementation challenges.
* Build trusted customer relationships by providing technical leadership and consulting throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop reusable delivery assets, best practices, and innovative approaches that improve delivery quality and efficiency.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the growth of the regional consulting practice.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 4–8 years of consulting, enterprise software implementation, or solution delivery experience. Strong candidates with slightly less experience may also be considered.
* Experience delivering enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions within Banking, Financial Services, FinTech, or Payments organizations.
* Experience leading technical workstreams and working directly with customers, business stakeholders, and technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within regional and global delivery teams.
* Willingness to travel across Asia Pacific as required.

**Technical & Domain Expertise**

* Experience implementing enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions.
* Experience with Financial Crime platforms such as SAS, NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM, FICO, Quantexa, Symphony AI NetReveal, or equivalent enterprise solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, Linux/Unix, ETL, APIs, cloud technologies (including Kubernetes), and enterprise application integration.
* Understanding of Fraud and Financial Crime domains including Payment Fraud, Card Fraud, Digital Banking Fraud, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC), and Financial Crime Investigations.

**Who You Are**
**You are someone who:**

* Enjoys solving complex business and technology challenges.
* Takes ownership and consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.
* Builds trusted relationships through professionalism, credibility, and collaboration.
* Communicates confidently with customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
* Has a growth mindset with a passion for continuous learning and mastering new technologies.
* Thrives in collaborative, multicultural consulting environments.
* Is passionate about helping customers combat fraud and financial crime.
* Aspires to become a Solution Architect, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader.

**Career Growth**
At SAS, you'll work on some of the largest Fraud and Financial Crime transformation programmes across Asia Pacific while collaborating with industry experts and leading financial institutions.
  
  
This role provides an excellent opportunity to build deep expertise across Fraud & Security Intelligence solutions while progressing towards Solution Architect, Project Lead, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader roles within SAS Professional Services.
  
  
You'll be encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, continuously develop your expertise, and contribute to the growth of one of Asia Pacific's leading Fraud & Security Intelligence consulting practices.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Job Description: Cloud Security Engineer
  
  
Reports to: Security Lead
  
  
Level: Mid (IC)
  
  
Mission
  
  
Own the identity, access, and network security control plane — CyberArk, Zscaler and Cloudflare — for a fast-scaling, AI-driven insurance infrastructure org. You'll take these tools from initial deployment handoff to steady, auditable, day-2 operations, and be the technical backbone the Security Lead relies on for privileged access and network security posture.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  

* CyberArk (PAM) — safe/policy design, privileged account lifecycle, credential rotation monitoring, access recertification
* Zscaler (SSE) — policy tuning, app onboarding, exception handling
* Cloudflare (WAF/CDN, and Zero Trust/Access if applicable) — rule tuning, DNS, edge security posture

Key responsibilities
  
  

* Take over day-2 administration of CyberArk from the implementation partner; ensure clean runbooks/SOPs exist and are maintained
* Run privileged access onboarding/offboarding and periodic access recertification, feeding evidence to the GRC Analyst for audit cycles
* Own Zscaler and Cloudflare policy baselines; manage exceptions without degrading security posture
* Partner with engineering teams as headcount scales to keep IAM and network controls usable, not just secure
* Support technical deep-dives requested by auditors or pen testers on identity/network architecture
* Identify opportunities to automate policy-drift detection and routine PAM/SSE administration, in line with the team's AI-driven, lean operating model
* Escalate control-design questions or audit findings on these tools to the Security Lead

What we're looking for
  
  

* 3–6+ years in security engineering, with hands-on ownership of at least one PAM platform (CyberArk strongly preferred) in production
* Working experience with a cloud SSE/ZTNA platform (Zscaler, Cloudflare Access, or similar) and a CDN/WAF
* Comfortable being the sole owner of high-scrutiny controls in an audited environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar)
* Strong scripting/automation ability (Python, Terraform, or similar) to keep a lean team's operational load sustainable
* Clear written communication — you'll produce evidence and explanations auditors and pen testers can follow

Nice to have
  
  

* Insurance, financial services, or other regulated-industry background
* Experience standing up or maturing a PAM program from a fresh implementation
* Exposure to NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law or similar state insurance regulatory frameworks

How we'll know you're succeeding
  
  

* CyberArk, Zscaler, and Cloudflare pass audit control tests with minimal findings
* Privileged access recertification completed on schedule every cycle
* No unplanned production impact from policy changes across owned tools
* Routine administration increasingly automated rather than manual quarter over quarter

title: Operational Risk, Assistant Manager
description:
Role Summary
  
  
State Street uses third parties to support internal processes and the delivery of products and services to clients. These relationships are evaluated and risk-assessed through the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Program.
  
  
The Third-Party Risk Management Associate will support the effective execution of activities across one or more TPRM lifecycle pillars. Depending on business requirements, the role may include reviewing TPRM cases and engagement records, reviewing and challenging inherent risk assessments, coordinating supplier due diligence outreach, monitoring and reviewing due diligence submissions, preparing executive summaries, and managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate will apply sound risk judgement, identify and resolve data or process inconsistencies, maintain complete and accurate records, and communicate TPRM requirements and assessment outcomes clearly. The role requires close collaboration with Engagement Managers, third-party suppliers, risk-domain subject matter experts, Business Advisors, Procurement, Legal, and TPRM teams to support timely, consistent, policy-aligned, and audit-ready outcomes.
  
  
**Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of State Street’s business lines, products and services, third-party operating model, and TPRM lifecycle requirements.
* Review and evaluate TPRM SNOW cases, Archer engagement records, assessment records, and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable policies, standards and procedures
* Manage assigned case queues, review and effectively challenge TPRM cases and support business lines in faster onboarding of third-party suppliers.
* Identify inconsistencies or gaps in inherent risk questionnaire responses and work with Engagement Managers and relevant stakeholders to resolve issues before approval.
* Apply knowledge of inherent risk questionnaire logic, scoring, question interdependencies, and due diligence triggers to confirm that the resulting inherent risk rating and due diligence requirements are appropriate.
* Prepare and distribute due diligence questionnaires and supporting requirements to third-party suppliers or internal service providers within established timelines.
* Monitor due diligence progress, perform follow-ups and escalations, and maintain clear records of outreach, responses, decisions, and outstanding actions.
* Perform completeness and quality reviews of returned due diligence questionnaires and supporting artifacts before routing the assessment to the appropriate risk-domain subject matter experts.
* Coordinate follow-up questions, clarification discussions, and supplier meetings; track responses and facilitate resolution of outstanding items.
* Review and analyze due diligence results, assessment conclusions, control-effectiveness ratings, and identified findings to confirm that outcomes are sufficiently supported and accurately documented.
* Prepare clear, concise, and audit-ready executive summaries that communicate the engagement scope, inherent risk profile, due diligence results, control effectiveness, findings, residual concerns, and required acknowledgement or next steps.
* Coordinate executive-summary review and issuance with Engagement Managers, Executive Sponsors, Business Advisors, risk-domain subject matter experts, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with third-party suppliers, Engagement Managers, business stakeholders, Procurement, Legal, risk-domain subject matter experts, and TPRM partner teams.
* Explain TPRM requirements, risk-analysis conclusions, findings, and remediation expectations clearly and professionally, and guide stakeholders toward timely resolution.
* Ensure that TPRM decisions, approvals, exceptions, and supporting evidence are accurately captured in Archer and relevant repositories to support governance, audit, and regulatory review.
* Support the preparation of management information, metrics, trend analysis, and status reporting for TPRM leadership and governance forums.
* Maintain and enhance procedures, checklists, templates, job aids, frequently asked questions, and other process documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, data quality, control effectiveness, stakeholder experience, and consistency of TPRM outcomes.
* Participate in system testing, process-change initiatives, remediation programmes, quality-assurance reviews, audits, and regulatory inspections.
* Maintain flexibility to work across TPRM pillars and support emerging programmed priorities arising from business, regulatory, policy, technology, or operating-model changes.
* Perform all responsibilities in accordance with State Street’s risk appetite, policies, standards, ethical requirements, and control expectations.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of third-party risk management principles, lifecycle activities, and governance requirements within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Sound risk judgement and the ability to assess the reasonableness, completeness, and consistency of information and supporting evidence.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify gaps, challenge assumptions, and develop practical resolution paths.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong stakeholder and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes while maintaining professional and constructive working relationships.
* Ability to manage multiple cases, competing priorities, and tight deadlines in a high-volume, control-focused environment.
* Strong organizational, documentation, and time-management skills, with close attention to detail.
* Strong customer-centric mindset and commitment to providing clear guidance and responsive support to business and supplier stakeholders.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and related reporting tools.
* Working knowledge of Archer or a comparable governance, risk, and compliance platform is preferred.
* High ethical standards, professional integrity, and commitment to maintaining appropriate confidentiality.

**Qualifications**

* Overall professional experience of 7 or more years, preferably within banking, financial services, risk management, compliance, procurement, audit, controls, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in Third-Party Risk Management, operational risk, supplier risk, vendor management, due diligence, or another risk-and-control function.
* Practical experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: TPRM case review, inherent risk assessment, due diligence outreach and completeness review, risk assessment coordination, findings management, executive-summary preparation, or stakeholder relationship management.
* General knowledge of third-party risk domains, including Operational Resiliency, Operational Risk, Cybersecurity, Information Sensitivity and Access, Privacy, Physical Security, Reputational Risk, Compliance, Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Bribery and Corruption, Financial Viability, and Tax Evasion.
* Experience working with internal stakeholders, third-party suppliers, and subject matter experts in a matrixed and globally distributed organization.
* Experience preparing management reporting, governance materials, executive communications, audit evidence, or regulatory-response documentation is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in business or a postgraduate management qualification is preferred.
* Relevant professional certification such as CRVPM, CRISC, CISM, CISA, CBCI, or an equivalent risk-management qualification is advantageous.
* Prior experience with Archer or a comparable governance, risk, and compliance platform is preferred.
* Please note: The role is required to support internal clients during the first half of US working hours.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

description:
**Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint)**
The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint) is a senior technical practitioner responsible specifically for the engineering, administration, governance, reliability, migration, and continuous improvement of the firm’s enterprise SharePoint Online environment. This role serves as the technical subject matter expert for SharePoint within the Messaging and Productivity Platforms function. This is a Hybrid role and works in 2pm-11pm IST shift.

The engineer will own the technical administration and engineering of SharePoint Online and play a significant role in SharePoint migrations, tenant consolidations, mergers and acquisitions, content remediation, lifecycle management, governance, and automation.
  
  
**SharePoint Online Administration & Engineering**

* Engineer, administer, and continuously improve the enterprise SharePoint Online environment.

* Establish and maintain standards for site architecture, provisioning, permissions, ownership, sharing, and lifecycle management.
* Manage and monitor SharePoint storage, site collections, access, configuration, and platform health.
* Develop scalable technical solutions for SharePoint administration and management.
* Evaluate SharePoint Online product changes and assess their potential impact on the enterprise environment.

* Develop automation using PowerShell, PnP PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, APIs, and other appropriate technologies.

**SharePoint Migration Engineering;**

* Analyze sites, content, permissions, metadata, links, customizations, dependencies, and other migration considerations.

title: Zscaler Engineer (Available to join in 0-30 days)
description:
**Job Description: Zscaler Engineer**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a skilled
**Network Security Engineer**
with a strong focus on
**Zscaler**
technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for managing, configuring, and optimizing our secure cloud transformation and network security infrastructure.
  
  
This is a
**Hybrid**
role. Candidates must be located in or willing to relocate to one of our office hubs.
  
  
**Key Information**

* Total Experience: 5 to 7 years in Network Security
* Zscaler Experience: 2 to 3 years of dedicated, hands-on experience (Mandatory)
* Job Type: Hybrid
* Locations: Pune, Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, Kolkata, Hyderabad
* Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days max

**Key Responsibilities**

* Zscaler Management: Handle the deployment, configuration, policy administration, and troubleshooting of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA).
* Traffic Redirection & Engineering: Manage and maintain Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) deployments, PAC files, and traffic redirection methods (GRE/IPSec tunnels).
* Security Policy Administration: Configure and monitor URL filtering, SSL inspection, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and Advanced Threat Protection (ATP) policies.
* Network Security Operations: Support traditional network security controls including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), intrusion prevention systems (IPS), and secure web gateways.
* Operations & Troubleshooting: Serve as the escalation point for complex network security issues, utilizing packet capture tools (Wireshark) to diagnose connectivity and performance anomalies.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the infrastructure and network teams to ensure smooth integration of Zscaler with SD-WAN and cloud environments (AWS/Azure).

**Required Skills & QualificationsZscaler Expertise (Mandatory)**

* 2–3 years of direct experience with ZIA (Cloud Firewall, Sandbox, Native SSL decryption).
* 2–3 years of direct experience with ZPA (App Connectors, Access Policies, User Portals).
* Proven experience troubleshooting Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) issues on Windows, macOS, or Linux.

**Core Network Security & Networking**

* Production experience with at least one major firewall platform (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point).
* Solid understanding of core routing and switching concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, OSPF, SD-WAN).
* Good grasp of standard authentication protocols (SAML, Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) as they integrate with Zscaler.

**Logistical Requirements**

* Must be available to join immediately or within a 30-day notice period.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA) or Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP).
* Certification in firewall technologies (e.g., PCNSE, NSE 4).
* CCNA/CCNP Security.

**What We Offer**

* Hybrid work flexibility balancing collaborative in-office days with focused remote work.
* Direct exposure to enterprise-scale cloud security migrations.
* Competitive compensation and clear technical career progression.

title: Data Privacy Consultant
description:
**Company:**
ComplyZen Security Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (Mumbai locals preferred)

**Work Mode:**
Remote, with client site visits as required

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Travel Requirement:**
Occasional travel to client locations, primarily as required for consulting engagements

About ComplyZen

ComplyZen Security Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a RegTech company focused on simplifying Governance, Risk, Compliance (GRC), cybersecurity, and data privacy for startups, MSMEs, and enterprises. Through its compliance management platforms and consulting services, ComplyZen helps organizations streamline compliance activities, manage risks, improve operational efficiency, and maintain audit readiness.

ComplyZen supports organizations in implementing and maintaining regulatory and industry frameworks, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and other applicable security and privacy requirements. Our goal is to make compliance practical, accessible, and affordable through technology-enabled solutions and expert consulting.

About the Role

ComplyZen is seeking a
**Data Privacy Consultant**
based in Mumbai to support client engagements involving data privacy compliance, privacy risk assessments, regulatory gap analysis, documentation, and implementation of privacy controls.

This is a remote-first role. However, the candidate must be willing and available to visit client offices when required for stakeholder discussions, assessments, workshops, implementation support, and compliance reviews.

The consultant will work closely with clients and ComplyZen's internal consulting, product, and information security teams to translate regulatory requirements into practical, implementable privacy controls. The role requires strong analytical skills, regulatory awareness, documentation capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple client engagements independently.

Key Responsibilities1. Data Privacy Compliance and Assessments

* Conduct privacy compliance assessments, regulatory gap analyses, and data protection maturity reviews.
* Support client readiness assessments for India's DPDPA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other applicable privacy regulations.
* Identify compliance gaps, assess privacy risks, and develop practical remediation plans.
* Assist in identifying applicable regulatory obligations based on client business activities, geography, and data processing practices.

2. Privacy Documentation and Governance

* Draft, review, and maintain privacy notices, privacy policies, data retention and deletion procedures, data handling guidelines, and internal privacy standards.
* Support the preparation and maintenance of Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), data inventories, data flow documentation, and data classification records.
* Assist with Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), privacy impact assessments, and legitimate-interest or other relevant assessments where applicable.
* Review data processing agreements, vendor privacy requirements, consent documentation, and data subject request procedures.
* Support the development of privacy governance frameworks, roles, responsibilities, and operating procedures.

3. Implementation and Risk Management

* Help clients implement privacy controls and address identified compliance gaps.
* Coordinate with IT, information security, legal, HR, business, and vendor management teams to operationalize privacy requirements.
* Support third-party privacy risk assessments and reviews of cloud-based and SaaS environments.
* Assist with privacy incident response procedures, breach assessment workflows, escalation processes, and regulatory notification readiness.
* Track remediation activities and maintain evidence of compliance.

4. Client Engagement and Site Visits

* Conduct remote client meetings, stakeholder interviews, and compliance workshops.
* Visit client locations in Mumbai and other agreed locations, as required by project scope.
* Facilitate onsite assessments, evidence collection, awareness sessions, and implementation reviews.
* Present assessment findings, explain regulatory requirements, and communicate actionable recommendations to client stakeholders.
* Manage assigned engagements, deliverables, timelines, and client communications independently.

5. Compliance Platform and Internal Collaboration

title: Security Operations Center Analyst
description:
**Job Title : SOC Analyst – L2**

**Experience : 3+ to 5+ Years of Experience in Security Operations**

**Location : Mumbai : BKC (Bandra Kurla Complex - Work from Office)**

**Job Summary :**

We are looking for an experienced and highly analytical
**SOC Analyst L2**
to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) / Cyber Defense Center (CDC). The SOC Analyst L2 will serve as an advanced incident responder responsible for investigating complex security incidents, conducting advanced threat hunting activities, developing detection use cases, and supporting security monitoring platforms such as
**IBM QRadar**
and
**SentinelOne EDR/XDR**
.

The candidate should possess deep expertise in incident investigation, malware analysis, threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, SIEM content development, and security operations processes. The role requires close collaboration with IT, Cloud, Engineering, and Security teams to enhance the organization's overall detection and response capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Security Monitoring & Incident Response**

* Perform in-depth investigation and analysis of security alerts escalated from L1 analysts.
* Lead the triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities for cybersecurity incidents.
* Handle high-severity and critical incidents, including malware outbreaks, ransomware attacks, account compromises, insider threats, and advanced persistent threats (APTs).
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and provide actionable remediation recommendations.
* Act as an escalation point for complex security investigations.

**Threat Hunting & Threat Intelligence**

* Conduct proactive threat hunting using endpoint, network, cloud, and identity telemetry.
* Leverage threat intelligence feeds, Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), Indicators of Attack (IOAs), and TTPs to identify emerging threats.
* Map attack techniques to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and identify gaps in detection coverage.
* Develop advanced hunting queries and investigative methodologies to uncover hidden threats.
* Monitor threat actor trends and emerging attack campaigns relevant to the organization's environment.

**Detection Engineering & Use Case Development**

* Design, develop, and optimize SIEM correlation rules and security analytics.
* Create and enhance custom dashboards, workbooks, reports, and visualizations.
* Perform alert tuning and reduce false positives while improving detection effectiveness.
* Develop security use cases aligned to threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve logging and visibility across enterprise environments.

**SIEM & EDR Administration**

* Manage and optimize IBM QRadar SIEM for monitoring, correlation, and investigations.
* Perform advanced investigations using SentinelOne EDR/XDR.
* Support onboarding and parsing new log sources.
* Develop custom integrations for unsupported data sources.
* Ensure data quality, normalization, and log source health across monitoring platforms.

**Malware, Phishing & Forensics Analysis**

* Analyze malware samples, suspicious files, and malicious URLs.
* Investigate phishing incidents utilizing email security tools and threat intelligence.
* Conduct endpoint investigations and digital forensic triage activities.
* Review attack chains and identify attacker techniques and persistence mechanisms.
* Document findings with detailed forensic timelines and recommendations.

**Incident Management & Process Improvement**

* Develop and maintain SOC playbooks, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
* Participate in incident response tabletop exercises and simulation activities.
* Identify automation opportunities and support SOAR implementation initiatives.
* Review security incidents and recommend process improvements.
* Contribute to SOC maturity and continuous improvement programs.

**Collaboration & Mentorship**

* Mentor and guide L1 analysts during investigations and incident triage.
* Review and validate incident reports generated by junior team members.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, identity, and network teams for remediation activities.
* Provide technical expertise during internal and customer-facing security discussions.
* Participate in executive and customer incident briefings as required.

**Experience & Technical Skills**

* Minimum
  **3+ to 5+ years of experience in a SOC, Incident Response, Threat Detection, or Cyber Defense role.**
* Minimum
  **2+ years of hands-on experience with IBM QRadar SIEM.**
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **SentinelOne EDR/XDR**
  .
* Experience leading investigations of complex and critical security incidents.
* Proven experience in threat hunting and incident response activities.

**Security Operations**

* Advanced incident response and investigation skills.
* Threat detection and threat hunting expertise.
* Malware analysis and phishing investigation experience.
* Security monitoring and event correlation.
* Digital forensics and endpoint investigations.

**Frameworks & Methodologies**

* MITRE ATT&CK Framework.
* Cyber Kill Chain.
* NIST Incident Response Framework.
* Threat Intelligence Lifecycle.
* Security Operations Best Practices.

**SIEM & EDR**

* IBM QRadar administration and content management.
* Correlation rule creation and optimization.
* Dashboard and report development.
* SentinelOne EDR/XDR investigation capabilities.
* Alert tuning and use-case engineering.

**Networking & Security Fundamentals**

* TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP.
* IDS/IPS, Firewalls, Proxy Technologies.
* Network traffic analysis.
* Active Directory and Identity Management.
* Cloud security monitoring.

**Scripting & Automation**

* Security Automation and SOAR platforms

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Managed Security Services (MSSP) environments.
* Experience with threat intelligence platforms.
* Experience building custom parsers, DSMs, and integrations.
* Experience with vulnerability management and attack surface monitoring.
* Experience working in customer-facing consulting engagements.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture.
* Experience performing purple team, threat emulation, or adversary simulation exercises.

**Preferred Certifications**

The following certifications are highly desirable:

**Industry Certifications**

* CompTIA CySA+
* CompTIA Security+
* EC-Council Certified SOC Analyst (CSA)
* EC-Council Certified Incident Handler (ECIH)
* GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
* GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)
* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
* CISSP (Associate or Certified)
* IBM QRadar SIEM Certifications
* SentinelOne Certifications
* Splunk Enterprise Security Certifications

A successful L2 SOC Analyst will:

* Independently investigate and resolve complex security incidents.
* Identify advanced threats through proactive threat hunting.
* Develop high-quality detection content and SIEM use cases.
* Reduce alert fatigue through effective tuning and optimization.
* Improve overall security visibility and detection coverage.
* Mentor junior analysts and contribute to SOC operational maturity.
* Drive continuous improvements in security monitoring, incident response, and threat intelligence integration.

description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
Global Technology Services (GTS) owns the management of a large and complex set of outsourcing arrangements. These arrangements include relationships with third‑party service providers as well as internal agreements across legal entities and business lines.
  
  
The IT Vendor Performance and Outsourcing Management (VPOM) team is established within GTS to:

The Senior Associate – IT Vendor Governance supports the execution of vendor governance processes across IT vendors, ensuring compliance with enterprise policies, contractual standards, and regulatory expectations. * undefine

**Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement-**

* Prepare periodic vendor governance dashboards, scorecards, and MIS reports.

* Assist with tracking contractual obligations, SLAs, KPIs, and compliance metrics.
* Support review of statements of work (SOWs), change requests, and governance clauses from a policy‑alignment perspective.
* Monitor SLA performance data and escalate deviations as required.

**Risk & Compliance Support-**

* Coordinate vendor risk assessments (e.g., TPRM, SOC reports, information security reviews) under guidance from senior team members.
* Track risk findings, remediation actions, and follow-ups with vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Support audit and regulatory requests by compiling evidence and governance documentation

**What We Value**

* Basic understanding of IT vendor management, outsourcing models, and third‑party risk concepts.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
* Ability to liaise across multiple stakeholders and functions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Willingness to learn and grow within a governance function.

**Mandatory Skills / Experience**

* Degree level qualification in Technology/Business or other relevant subject with overall experience of 3 - 5 years in IT/Non IT Vendor Management, IT/Non IT Governance, Outsourcing Management, Third‑Party Management, or a related technology governance / operations role.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a structured environment.
* Experience working in a regulated financial services, banking, or large enterprise environment preferred, with exposure to internal controls and audit expectations.
* Demonstrated ability to follow standardized, repeatable governance processes consistently and accurately.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Power BI, Sharepoint) for reporting, governance tracking, and documentation.

**Additional Requirements / Good To Have Skills**

* Certification in Project management, Agile, Kaizen will be a plus.
* Work experience supporting multiple geographies is an added advantage
* Experience in execution transformation programs/project is a plus

**Mode of work:**
Compliant with State Street Policy of Work from office/home
  
  
**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**
We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.
  
  
We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.
  
  
Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.
  
  
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. title: Lead Security Engineer
description:
All positionsLead Security Engineer EngineeringMumbai, IndiaFull-time Apply Now

**About the Role**

As Lead Security Engineer at IQWorks, you will own security for a platform whose entire promise is protecting sensitive data. Security is not a feature bolted on at the end here — it is the product, and you will be the person who holds the bar. You will own our zero-trust architecture and the strict data-isolation guarantees that keep every customer's data separate, and you will make sure those guarantees hold as the platform grows. You will threat-model new features, run security reviews on the code we ship, harden our cloud and on-premise deployments, and lead our response when something needs attention. You will stay hands-on — reading code, writing tooling, and fixing issues at the root — while setting the standards and secure-by-default patterns the whole engineering team builds around. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thinks like an attacker, builds like an engineer, and treats customer trust as the thing worth protecting.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the security posture of the IQWorks platform, from application code to infrastructure to on-premise deployments
* Guard the zero-trust data-isolation model — keep multi-tenant separation airtight and enforce least-privilege access end to end
* Threat-model new features and lead security reviews before they ship, working alongside the engineering team
* Build and automate security tooling — static and dynamic analysis, dependency and secret scanning, and CI security gates
* Run vulnerability management end to end: triage, prioritize, and drive fixes at the root cause
* Lead incident response — detection, containment, remediation, and blameless post-mortems
* Harden cloud and on-premise/edge environments so enterprises can process sensitive data without it leaving their infrastructure
* Support enterprise security reviews and our compliance and certification program (SOC 2, ISO 27001, and similar)
* Set secure-by-default patterns and raise the security bar across the team as the company scales

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5+ years in security engineering, application security, or software engineering with a heavy security focus
* Strong grasp of web application security — the OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, and secure application design
* Hands-on experience securing multi-tenant SaaS, including database-level access controls and data isolation
* Ability to read and write production code (TypeScript, and a backend language such as Go or Python) and fix issues yourself, not just file them
* Experience with threat modeling, security reviews, and vulnerability management in a shipping product
* Working knowledge of cloud security and hardening, and comfort reasoning about on-premise and edge deployments
* Effective use of AI as a force multiplier across the security workflow — reviewing code, triaging findings, and building tooling — with sharp judgment about where human oversight is essential so security is never compromised
* Clear communication and the ability to work directly with engineering, product, and founders in a fast-moving startup

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with database-enforced authorization and fine-grained access-control models
* Background in data privacy, compliance, or governance, and familiarity with regulations such as DPDPA, GDPR, or HIPAA
* Experience driving SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar certifications

Co-founded by industry pioneers Sharad Sanghi and Anindya Das, Neysa brings together deep expertise across AI, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity to build products for the next generation of technology adoption.

Its flagship product, Neysa Velocis, is a full-stack AI acceleration platform built for modern AI workloads—from training and fine-tuning to inference. It brings together compute, orchestration, security, and observability to help organizations adopt and scale AI faster, safer, and more efficiently.

**The Opportunity: Build AI Products with Security at the Core**

As a Product Manager – AI & Information Security, you will own and drive product initiatives at the intersection of AI, cloud, and cybersecurity.

You will work closely with engineering, security, design, sales, customer success, and other stakeholders to identify customer problems, define product requirements, prioritize the roadmap, and take products from concept to launch.

This is a hands-on product management role for someone who understands both the opportunities created by AI and the security challenges that come with deploying AI and cloud technologies at scale.

You will be expected to bring strong product thinking along with enough technical depth to work effectively with engineering and security teams, understand complex technology concepts, and translate them into scalable enterprise products.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the product lifecycle from problem discovery and ideation through roadmap, development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Define and maintain the product roadmap, prioritizing initiatives based on customer needs, business impact, technical feasibility, and market opportunity.
* Work closely with engineering and security teams to define product requirements, user stories, workflows, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Translate complex AI, cloud, and information security concepts into clear product requirements and user experiences.

* Collaborate with Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success teams to understand customer requirements and support product adoption.
* Define product positioning, value propositions, and launch requirements in collaboration with GTM teams.
* Track product adoption, usage, customer feedback, and key product metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct competitive analysis across AI platforms, cloud providers, cybersecurity products, and emerging AI security solutions.
* Stay current with developments in GenAI, AI infrastructure, AI security, cloud security, cybersecurity, and enterprise technology and translate relevant trends into product opportunities.
* Work cross-functionally to drive product initiatives from concept to execution, while balancing customer needs, technical constraints, and business priorities.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* 4–10 years of experience in Product Management, with demonstrated ownership of technology products.
* Strong experience managing the end-to-end product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements, prioritization, roadmap, development, launch, and iteration.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams on technical or platform products.
* Strong understanding of product discovery, customer research, prioritization frameworks, product metrics, and roadmap management.
* Ability to convert complex customer and business problems into clear product requirements and actionable product roadmaps.
* Strong professional experience working on AI and/or Information Security products is essential.
* Hands-on understanding of AI/ML, GenAI, LLM applications, AI infrastructure, or AI platforms.
* Strong understanding of information security and cybersecurity concepts, with experience translating security requirements into product capabilities.
* Experience with one or more areas such as cloud security, application security, data security, identity and access management, security monitoring, threat detection, governance, risk, compliance, or AI security.
* Understanding of the security challenges associated with AI workloads, cloud environments, APIs, data, models, and enterprise AI adoption.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering, security, and technical teams and understand architectural discussions at a product level.
* Enterprise & Platform Products
* Experience building or managing B2B, enterprise, SaaS, cloud, cybersecurity, AI, or platform products.
* Exposure to products serving technical users, developers, IT teams, security teams, or enterprise customers.
* Experience gathering requirements directly from customers and translating them into product improvements.
* Understanding of enterprise buying journeys, adoption challenges, and technical evaluation processes is preferred.

**Core Competencies**

* AI & GenAI Product Management
* Information Security / Cybersecurity Product Management
* Cloud & Platform Products
* Product Discovery & Customer Research
* Product Strategy & Roadmapping
* Technical Product Management
* Requirements Definition & Prioritization
* Cross-functional Execution
* Customer & Market Understanding
* Product Analytics & Metrics
* Competitive Intelligence
* Enterprise Product Development

**Strategic & Analytical Competencies:**

* Product Thinking: Ability to identify meaningful customer problems, assess opportunities, define the right product solution, and prioritize effectively.
* Technical Depth: Ability to understand AI, cloud, cybersecurity, and platform technologies and collaborate effectively with engineering and security teams.
* Customer-Centricity: Strong ability to engage with customers and internal stakeholders to understand pain points and translate them into actionable product opportunities.
* Execution Excellence: Ability to move products from idea → requirements → development → launch → iteration, while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
* Data-Driven Decision Making: Use product usage, customer feedback, market intelligence, and business metrics to inform product decisions.
* Market & Competitive Understanding: Stay informed about developments across AI, cloud, cybersecurity, AI security, and enterprise technology and identify opportunities for differentiation.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 4–10 years of professional experience in Product Management or closely related product roles.
* Strong experience in AI, cybersecurity / information security, cloud, or related technology products.
* Demonstrated experience taking technology products from concept through development and launch.
* Experience working with engineering and technical teams in an agile product development environment.
* Experience with B2B / enterprise products is preferred.
* Experience in AI security, cloud security, cybersecurity platforms, AI infrastructure, or enterprise AI products will be highly relevant.

**Your Mindset**

* Builder mindset with a genuine interest in AI, cybersecurity, and emerging technology
* Comfortable getting into technical details without losing sight of the customer problem.

* Curious and comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving technology environment.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an experienced Security Engineer to join our Information Security team in Mumbai. In this role, you will help design, build, and maintain solutions that protect HRT’s global infrastructure, systems, and data within one of the world’s most advanced computing environments. You will have the opportunity to build and harness AI tools to solve cutting edge security problems. This is a senior-level, hands-on individual contributor role in cybersecurity, spanning both operations and compliance domains.

From an operational standpoint, you will be responsible for detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, cyber threat intelligence analysis, and adversary emulation exercises for our global infrastructure and systems.

You will also serve as HRT’s Designated Officer in India for applicable regulatory compliance purposes. Approximately 25% of the role will focus on regional regulatory and governance responsibilities, including control assessments, risk management, evidence collection and reporting, and coordination with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders, as well as auditors and regulators. This is not a people management position. We are looking for an experienced engineer who can independently own these responsibilities while remaining deeply involved in hands-on security work.

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with global Information Security, Compliance, Legal, and Engineering teams to support applicable regulation and local cybersecurity obligations
* Translate regulatory and security requirements into practical technical controls, implementation guidance, evidence, and reporting
* Assess security controls against applicable regulations and industry-standard frameworks, document risks and gaps, and coordinate remediation with accountable owners
* Build strong cross-functional relationships with HRT’s global teams, auditors, vendors, and other external stakeholders
* Help maintain HRT’s security detection and response program to protect our data and intellectual property from both internal and external threats
* Hunt for, detect, and respond to malicious activity and anomalous events on HRT’s devices and networks
* Conduct cyber threat intelligence research to identify relevant threat actors, and perform adversary emulation and purple teaming exercises
* Investigate security events and support incident response, including any required regional coordination, documentation, and reporting
* Work an on-call rotation on a predefined schedule

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in security engineering
* Experience with red teaming and penetration testing tools and techniques
* Firm grasp of emerging AI security threats and mitigating controls
* Experience using log analysis platforms such as ELK and Splunk
* Experience building, deploying, and supporting automated systems (Python preferred)
* Strong security fundamentals and experience working with Linux systems and command-line tools
* Experience supporting security governance, risk, compliance, or regulatory requirements, preferably within a heavily regulated industry
* Experience collaborating across technical and non-technical teams and communicating clearly with engineers, business stakeholders, auditors, and regulatory stakeholders
* Strong troubleshooting, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to independently drive work from problem definition through implementation
* Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, CIS, and SEBI CSCRF is preferred
* Experience working independently to deliver high-quality completed work

**Culture**

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.
  
  

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.
  
  
Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

Please be advised: Use of AI tools by an applicant during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon. We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

You can review our Global Applicant Privacy Notice, which explains how we process applicant information.

+ Identify and resolve authentication, authorization, policy, and operational issues.

* Documentation, Presentation, and Enterprise Enablement:

+ Develop comprehensive onboarding guides, standards, operating procedures, and implementation playbooks.
+ Create detailed integration documentation covering authentication methods, secrets engine configurations, onboarding requirements, troubleshooting, and support processes.
+ Maintain knowledge repositories, architecture standards, & onboarding documentation libraries.
+ Produce support documentation for operations and engineering teams.
+ Create reference architectures and implementation patterns for common onboarding scenarios.

* Stakeholder Engagement

+ Serve as the primary onboarding contact for application and platform teams.
+ Collaborate with cybersecurity, identity, cloud, DevOps, and infrastructure organizations.
+ Communicate onboarding timelines, risks, dependencies, and implementation recommendations.
+ Build strong relationships with engineering leadership and business stakeholders.
+ Support enterprise-wide secrets management transformation initiatives.

* Demonstrated success using scripts (PowerShell), python, bash to process data

:

* 3+ years of experience with HashiCorp Vault administration, engineering, or onboarding activities.

Using Aruba Central for centralized switch configuration and monitoring.
  
  
Configuring Aruba-specific features like Dynamic Segmentation and Zero Trust security enforcement.

Knowledge of Software Defined Networks and Network Function Virtualization technologies
  
  
You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.

title: Cyber Security GRC Consultant @ Mumbai
description:
Position: Cybersecurity GRC Consultant

Location: Mumbai

Duration: Contract to Hire

**Job Description: Cybersecurity GRC Consultant**

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Experience:**
4 years of relevant cybersecurity consulting and audit experience

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

We are seeking a knowledgeable and client-focused
**Cybersecurity GRC Consultant**
to support consulting, assessment, audit, compliance, and documentation engagements across information security, privacy, regulatory compliance, third-party risk, and cyber resilience. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience delivering cybersecurity GRC engagements for clients, interpreting regulatory requirements, conducting maturity and posture assessments, and preparing high-quality client-facing reports, policies, and remediation roadmaps.

Role Overview

The Cybersecurity GRC Consultant will work with clients across industries to assess, design, implement, and improve cybersecurity governance, risk, compliance, privacy, and resilience programs. The role requires strong consulting capability, audit experience, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate technical and regulatory requirements into actionable business controls.

The consultant will contribute to engagements involving ISO standards, NIST-based assessments, Indian financial-sector regulations, privacy compliance, third-party risk management, cyber risk assessment, policy development, awareness programs, and audit readiness.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct cybersecurity GRC consulting, assessment, audit, and advisory engagements for client organizations.
* Perform ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS gap assessments, internal audits, implementation support, risk assessments, control reviews, and certification-readiness activities.
* Support business continuity and resilience engagements aligned with ISO 22301, including BCMS documentation, business impact analysis, risk assessment, continuity planning, and exercise support.
* Conduct cybersecurity posture assessments, maturity assessments, control effectiveness reviews, and compliance gap assessments.
* Assess client environments against relevant frameworks and standards, including:
* ISO/IEC 27001:2022
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework and related NIST guidance
* SOC 2 Type II requirements
* Data Protection and Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA) requirements
* General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
* Data privacy principles, privacy governance, and privacy-by-design requirements
* RBI cybersecurity, IT governance, outsourcing, digital-payment, and related regulatory requirements
* SEBI cybersecurity and cyber-resilience requirements
* IRDAI cybersecurity, information security, and related regulatory requirements
* Lead or support cyber risk management activities, including risk identification, control mapping, risk scoring, treatment planning, risk-register maintenance, and management reporting.
* Conduct Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) assessments, including vendor due diligence, cybersecurity questionnaires, risk evaluation, contractual security requirements, and remediation tracking.
* Support SOC 2 Type II readiness reviews, control design assessments, evidence reviews, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
* Develop, review, and enhance cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, guidelines, frameworks, registers, and process documentation.
* Prepare client deliverables such as assessment reports, audit reports, gap-analysis reports, compliance matrices, risk registers, remediation roadmaps, executive presentations, and management dashboards.
* Conduct cybersecurity awareness and training programs for employees, management, and relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate client workshops, interviews, walkthroughs, evidence reviews, risk discussions, and leadership presentations.
* Track observations, nonconformities, risks, action plans, and closure evidence through the engagement lifecycle.
* Collaborate with technical, legal, privacy, business, audit, and compliance stakeholders to ensure practical implementation of cybersecurity controls.
* Keep abreast of evolving cybersecurity regulations, privacy requirements, threat trends, and industry best practices.
* Contribute to proposal development, scoping, pre-sales discussions, statements of work, and client presentations where required.

Required Experience and Skills

* 5–6 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity GRC consulting, information security consulting, IT audit, risk advisory, compliance, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with clients in a consulting, advisory, audit, or assurance capacity.
* Hands-on experience in ISO/IEC 27001 implementation, gap assessment, internal audit, risk assessment, control documentation, or certification-readiness engagements.
* Strong understanding of NIST cybersecurity frameworks and their practical application in assessment and improvement programs.
* Working knowledge of DPDPA, GDPR, data privacy governance, data lifecycle controls, consent management concepts, data-subject rights, and privacy risk assessments.
* Experience with RBI, SEBI, and IRDAI cybersecurity and regulatory expectations; experience supporting BFSI clients will be preferred.
* Experience in Third-Party Risk Management, including vendor security assessments, supplier due diligence, risk classification, and remediation follow-up.
* Experience in cybersecurity posture assessments, cyber maturity assessments, cyber risk assessments, and compliance gap assessments.
* Familiarity with SOC 2 Type II requirements, Trust Services Criteria, control mapping, audit evidence, and readiness activities.
* Strong capability in developing and reviewing cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, risk registers, control matrices, and compliance documentation.
* Experience in conducting cybersecurity training and awareness initiatives.
* Ability to interpret regulatory and framework requirements and translate them into practical, measurable, client-specific controls.
* Strong report-writing, documentation, presentation, stakeholder-management, and client communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent engagements, meet project timelines, and work independently with limited supervision.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and documentation/reporting tools.

Mandatory Certifications

Candidates must hold the following valid certifications:

* **ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Lead Auditor**
* **ISO 22301 Lead Auditor**
* **Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)**

Good-to-Have Certifications

The following certifications will be an added advantage:

* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor
* Other relevant certifications in privacy, risk management, cloud security, SOC, or business continuity

Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable engaging with senior client stakeholders. They should be able to balance compliance interpretation with practical business implementation, write clear and professional client deliverables, and confidently facilitate workshops and audits.

The role is best suited to a consultant who enjoys working across varied client environments and can independently drive cybersecurity GRC engagements from assessment through remediation planning and closure.

title: Entra ID SSO Consultant (short-term contract)
description:
Fixed-fee contract ·
**Duration:**
2–3 working days over about two weeks, plus one month on-call support ·
**Start:**
[week of 19 October 2026] ·
**Location:**
Remote, with one optional visit to Powai, Mumbai

**The project**

White Globe needs SAML single sign-on between our Microsoft 365 tenant and a client's translation platform, so our linguists sign in with White Globe-managed, coded IDs. You will set it up, test it with the client's engineer and hand it over to our in-house administrator.

**Scope**

1.      Check our Entra ID licence tier, admin roles and domain setup, and flag any gaps.

2.      Create a non-gallery enterprise application and configure SAML with the client's Entity ID and Reply URL.

3.      Configure claims to send only a coded user ID and a role — no real names or personal email.

4.      Create Translator, Reviser and SME Reviewer roles, matched to the client platform's role names.

5.      Create the first batch of coded linguist accounts with MFA (Microsoft Authenticator), and one shared notifications mailbox.

6.      Run a joint test with the client's engineer on three accounts.

7.      Hand over a one-page runbook and a 30-minute walkthrough.

8.      Provide one month of on-call support after go-live (sign-in issues, role changes, certificate questions).

**Deliverables:**
working SSO, configured application and roles, first batch of accounts, runbook, and a configuration record including the certificate expiry date.

**What you bring**

•        4+ years with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID (Azure AD).

•        At least two completed SAML 2.0 SSO setups for non-gallery applications with a third party.

•        Solid grasp of claims mapping, app roles vs security groups, user assignment and SAML signing certificates.

•        SC-300 or MS-102 certification, or experience in ISO 27001 or healthcare environments, is a plus.

**Terms**

•        Fixed fee for the full scope, plus a day rate for any extra work.

•        Payment in stages: 10% on start, 20% after a successful joint test, 50% at go-live, 20% at the end of on-call support.

•        NDA signed before access; work through a named admin account only.

**How to apply**

Email
**hr@whiteglobe.co.in**
with the subject "Entra ID SSO Consultant" by [date]. Include your fixed-fee quote (INR, GST separate), day rate, earliest start date, and a short note on two SSO setups you have done.
